title: Pricing page
prompt:
Build a pricing page at /pricing.

Requirements:
- A heading "Pricing".
- Three plan cards: Starter at $9 per month, Team at $29 per month and Business at $99 per month. Each card has a button "Choose <plan name>", for example "Choose Team".
- A "Monthly" and a "Yearly" toggle button. Monthly is selected at first. Choosing "Yearly" shows the yearly price, which is ten times the monthly price: $90, $290 and $990 per year.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
